author: Ari Koslow
title: Jarret Whorff signs minor league deal with Braves
desc: The Braves signed Jarret Whorff to a minor league contract.
impact: Whorff was previously in the Twins organization.

author: Chase Davis
title: Ivan Herrera swipes a bag in quiet loss to Padres
desc: Ivan Herrera went 1-for-3 in a loss to the Padres with a walk and one stolen base.
impact: After Wednesday's loss, Herrera is slashing .261/.398/.420 with nine home runs, 31 RBI, 48 runs scored and five steals across 72 games. He's got three steals in his last six games and is tied with Hunter Goodman for the lead at the position.

author: Chase Davis
title: Kyle Leahy fans seven but takes loss as Cards fall to Padres
desc: Kyle Leahy allowed three earned runs on seven hits and one walk while striking out seven over six innings in Wednesday's loss to the Padres.
impact: After the loss, Leahy owns a 4.63 ERA and 1.57 WHIP with a 5-4 record, and a 7.6 K/9 across 14 starts. It took him only 81 pitches to record his second quality start of the year. The seven strikeouts are nice to see in this one, but he had one strikeout in four innings two starts ago. His next opportunity comes against the Diamondbacks.

author: Chase Davis
title: Alex Call chips in RBI, swipe in one-run win
desc: Alex Call went 1-for-3 in win over the Rays with a walk, a run scored, an RBI and a stolen base while striking out once.
impact: After Wednesday's win, Call is batting .258 with 14 RBI, 15 runs scored, zero home runs and one stolen base across 43 games. He's started just five of his team's last 12 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Freddie Freeman clubs clutch homer as Dodgers edge Rays
desc: Freddie Freeman went 1-for-4 in a win over the Rays with a home run, one walk, two runs scored and two RBI.
impact: After Wednesday's win over Tampa Bay, Freeman is batting .279 with 12 home runs, 40 RBI, 41 runs scored and two steals across 72 games. Since the beginning of June, he's batting .306 with four homers, 12 runs scored and 11 RBI with a .394 OBP.

author: Nate Miller
title: Vidal Brujan outrighted to Triple-A
desc: Vidal Brujan was sent to Triple-A Syracuse on Thursday.
impact: Brujan was designated for assignment earlier this week. After clearing waivers, the Mets have sent the veteran utility man to Triple-A.

author: Chase Davis
title: Alex Vesia escapes with shaky save in 5-4 win
desc: Alex Vesia allowed no hits while walking two and striking out one in a scoreless appearance to earn the save in Wednesday's 5-4 win over the Rays.
impact: After Wednesday's save, Vesia now has a 2.59 ERA and 1.07 WHIP with three saves and 11 holds across 33 appearances. It took him 28 pitches to log the save. Tanner Scott and Will Klein were used each of the past two days and were likely unavailable in this one.

author: Chase Davis
title: Shohei Ohtani logs win, pinch hit appearance
desc: Shohei Ohtani allowed four earned runs on seven hits and one walk while striking out five over six innings in Wednesday's win over the Rays.
impact: Ohtani went 0-for-1 with a 107 mph groundout as a pinch hitter after exiting as a pitcher. After Wednesday's win, Ohtani has a 1.47 ERA, 0.88 WHIP, 9.5 K/9 and a 7-2 record across 12 starts. He's batting .296 with 15 home runs, 42 RBI, 51 runs scored and six stolen bases across 68 games at the plate. His next pitching chance will come against the Twins next Wednesday.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Tyrone Taylor (hip) to begin rehab assignment Friday
desc: Tyrone Taylor will begin his rehab assignment on Friday at Double-A Binghamton.
impact: Taylor has been on the injured list since May 26th with a hip flexor strain, but seems to be on track to return soon. The outfielder is slashing .186/.210/.320 in 97 at-bats this season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Francisco Lindor (calf) to begin rehab assignment Friday
desc: Francisco Lindor will begin his rehab assignment on Friday with Double-A Binghamton.
impact: Lindor has missed the majority of the season up to this point with a calf injury, as he has been on the injured list since April 23rd. The shortstop now seems to be on the verge of his return, but he may need about a week at the minor-league level before being back with the Mets. Team president David Sterns announced earlier that he expects Lindor back by the end of June.

author: Nate Miller
title: Kolby Allard agrees to minor-league deal with the Phillies
desc: Kolby Allard signed a minor-league contract with the Phillies on Thursday.
impact: Allard will head to Triple-A Lehigh Valley to provide organizational pitching depth for the Phillies. Allard has allowed 10 runs over just 8 2/3 innings out of the Cleveland bullpen earlier this year. He has been better at the Triple-A level this season, posting a 4.11 ERA with a 28-9 K/BB ratio across 30 2/3 innings.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Lombard placed on Triple-A IL
desc: George Lombard Jr. was placed on the 7-day injured list at Triple-A.
impact: Lombard is dealing with "a couple" of  sprained fingers on his left hand.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sean Burke to pitch in bulk relief role Thursday
desc: Sean Burke will pitch in a bulk relief role on Thursday against the Yankees.
impact: Burke will follow Bryan Hudson who is set to open for the White Sox.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryan Hudson to serve as opener Thursday
desc: Bryan Hudson will open for the White Sox on Thursday.
impact: Hudson will open in the first inning. Sean Burke will follow him in a bulk relief role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wenceel Perez to be placed on IL
desc: The Tigers are placing Wenceel Perez on the injured list.
impact: Perez was struck in the face by a plyo band Tuesday night in the training room. Tei Cruz is being called up as the corresponding move.
